title: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1
best_for_zh: 需要审计聚合 benchmark、组件权重、混合 verifier 和 leaderboard 可复现边界的读者。
one_line: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index aggregates multiple evaluations into a weighted model-quality score.
Artificial Analysis 智能指数把多个评测按权重合成为单一的模型质量分数。
why: It is useful as a benchmark-of-benchmarks example where the aggregate number is less reusable than its component contracts.
inclusion_reason: It is a visible aggregate model benchmark whose weights and mixed verifier contracts need explicit audit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index asks how to summarize broad language-model capability into one maintained comparison score. The primary source is the official Artificial Analysis Intelligence Benchmarking methodology page, currently describing Intelligence Index v4.1.

The decision boundary is that this is an aggregate benchmark methodology, not a primary dataset, training recipe, or proof that one model is universally better. The evaluation surface is a weighted suite of component tasks across agents, coding, scientific reasoning, and general knowledge.

Its value is audit-oriented: it exposes how a popular public index combines heterogeneous verifier contracts, from test suites and official grading servers to judge panels and equality-checker models.

Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 关注的问题是：如何把模型的多类能力压缩成一个持续维护的比较分数。主来源是 Artificial Analysis 官方智能基准方法页面，目前说明的是 v4.1。

边界是：它是聚合基准方法，不是原始数据集，不是训练配方，也不能证明某个模型在所有用例上更好。评测表面是一个加权套件，覆盖智能体、代码、科学推理和通用知识。

它的价值在于审计：这个指数把测试套件、官方评分服务器、评审组、等价性检查模型等不同反馈契约混合到一个公共分数里。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core contribution is a transparent aggregate index: v4.1 combines 9 evaluations with disclosed categories, task counts, repeats, response types, scoring rules, and weights. The mechanism is not a new single benchmark but a weighting policy over multiple existing and AA-maintained evaluations.

The closest comparison is a leaderboard that reports many benchmarks separately. The change is a single weighted synthesis, with agents weighted 34%, coding 24%, scientific reasoning 24%, and general tasks 18%.

The feedback contract is mixed, so the aggregate score should be read as a suite-level comparison rather than row-level evidence.

核心贡献是一个透明的聚合指数：v4.1 把 9 个评测按公开的类别、题量、重复次数、响应类型、评分规则和权重合成。机制不是提出单一新基准，而是对多个已有或 Artificial Analysis 维护的评测做加权。

最近的参照物是分别报告多个基准的排行榜。这里的变化是给出单一综合分：智能体 34%、代码 24%、科学推理 24%、通用能力 18%。

反馈契约是混合的，所以聚合分数应被读成套件层面的比较，而不是逐样本证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are model API responses on the component evaluations. The published v4.1 suite includes GDPval-AA v2, tau3-Banking, Terminal-Bench v2.1, SciCode, AA-LCR, AA-Omniscience, Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond, and CritPt.

Pipeline: run each component under the published testing settings, score with that component's verifier, normalize or aggregate repeats, then compute the weighted index. Outputs are component scores, category scores, and the final Intelligence Index.

Reproducibility requires pinning methodology version, benchmark snapshots, repeats, prompts, model API date, temperature, token limits, tool access, judge/equality-checker versions, and leaderboard date.

输入是模型在各个组件评测上的输出。官方 v4.1 套件包括 GDPval-AA v2、tau3-Banking、Terminal-Bench v2.1、SciCode、AA-LCR、AA-Omniscience、Humanity's Last Exam、GPQA Diamond 和 CritPt。

流程是：按公开测试设置运行各组件，用组件自己的验证器或评分器打分，聚合重复实验结果，再按权重计算 Intelligence Index。输出包括组件分数、类别分数和最终指数。

复现前必须固定方法版本、基准快照、重复次数、提示词、模型 API 日期、温度、输出长度限制、工具访问权限、评审模型/等价性检查模型版本和排行榜日期。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official methodology page reports the v4.1 component list and weights, and states a 95% confidence interval below about plus/minus 1% for the aggregate index based on repeated experiments on selected models. It also discloses general testing parameters, including different temperature treatment for reasoning and non-reasoning models.

The strongest evidence is the component-level score under each verifier, not the final weighted number alone. A Terminal-Bench result has a different evidentiary meaning from a judge-panel GDPval-AA result or an equality-checker open-answer result.

The evidence boundary is that internal dataset copies, some AA-specific variants, and exact runner state were not verified as downloadable artifacts.

官方方法页面报告了 v4.1 的组件列表和权重，并说明基于部分模型重复实验，聚合指数的 95% 置信区间小于约正负 1%。页面也披露了通用测试参数，包括推理模型和非推理模型的温度差异。

真正强的证据是各组件在各自验证器下的组件级分数，而不是最终加权数。Terminal-Bench 的测试套件证据、GDPval-AA 的评审组证据、开放答案等价性检查证据含义并不一样。

证据边界是：内部数据副本、部分 Artificial Analysis 专用变体和精确运行器状态没有被核验为可下载工件。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior baseline is a multi-benchmark leaderboard that leaves readers to mentally combine scores. Artificial Analysis changes that by publishing one weighted score and the weights behind it.

The quality signal is the explicit table of categories, task counts, repeats, response types, scoring rules, and tool-usage flags. What is not new is any single component benchmark or verifier type.

Before reuse, inspect whether the aggregate weighting matches the intended use case, whether private/internal component copies are acceptable, and whether component-level scores tell a different story from the final index.

已有基线是多基准排行榜，读者需要自己综合分数。Artificial Analysis 的变化是发布一个加权总分，并公开权重。

质量信号是明确列出类别、任务数量、重复次数、响应类型、评分规则和工具使用标记。不新的是任何单个组件基准或验证器类型。

复用前要检查聚合权重是否符合目标用例，私有或内部组件副本是否可接受，以及组件级分数是否和最终指数给出不同结论。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The index is text-only and English-only, while image, speech, and multilingual performance are evaluated separately. A strong aggregate score can hide weak component performance.

Several components rely on judge models, equality checkers, official servers, or internally maintained benchmark copies. Those dependencies make the score sensitive to methodology version, API behavior, and access policy.

Do not use the aggregate number as row-level evidence or as a reward signal without separately auditing each component's verifier contract.

这个指数只覆盖文本、只覆盖英语；图像、语音和多语种表现由其他评测处理。高聚合分数可能掩盖某些组件的弱项。

多个组件依赖评审模型、等价性检查器、官方服务器或内部维护的基准副本。因此分数会受方法版本、API 行为和访问策略影响。

不要把聚合数字当成逐样本证据，也不要在未审计各组件反馈契约前把它当奖励信号使用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this methodology as an example of benchmark-suite documentation. It is useful when deciding how to report a composite score without hiding component contracts.

Reusable records should keep component name, version, weight, task count, repeat count, response type, scoring rule, tool access, model API snapshot, and aggregate formula.

For benchmark audits, the most useful move is to compare the final index with per-category and per-component results before drawing capability conclusions.

这套方法适合作为基准套件文档的例子。它有助于判断如何报告综合分数，同时不隐藏组件契约。

可复用记录应保留组件名称、版本、权重、任务数量、重复次数、响应类型、评分规则、工具访问权限、模型 API 快照和聚合公式。

做基准审计时，最有用的是把最终指数、分类别结果和分组件结果一起看，再下能力结论。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read the component table before the leaderboard number. The index is a policy choice about weighting capability surfaces.

Keep three layers separate: component verifier result, category aggregate, and final weighted index. They answer different questions.

Version drift is central: "Intelligence Index" without a methodology version and date is not a reproducible claim.

先读组件表，再读排行榜数字。这个指数本质上是关于能力表面如何加权的策略选择。

要分开三层：组件验证结果、类别聚合结果、最终加权指数。它们回答的问题不同。

版本漂移是核心风险：只说 “Intelligence Index” 而不标方法版本和日期，不是可复现声明。
